title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect Wisal to your ERP and communication providers
notice: Saving a connection stores its configuration and checks that the endpoint is reachable. A connected ERP can also pull customer records in and push ticket and CSAT events out, on the Sync tab. Sending and receiving messages per provider (email, SMS, WhatsApp) is not enabled in this release.

erp.label: ERP
erp.help: Sync customer and order records from your ERP system into Wisal tickets.

email.label: Email
email.help: Receive and send support tickets through a connected email inbox.

sms.label: SMS
sms.help: Send and receive customer replies over SMS.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.help: Handle customer conversations over WhatsApp Business.

api_webhook.label: Custom API / Webhook
api_webhook.help: Push and pull ticket data through a custom API endpoint.

form.savedHint: Saved key ends in {{last4}}. Leave blank to keep it.
form.testHelp: Checks that the endpoint responds. It does not verify that the provider accepts the key.

error.unreachable: Couldn't reach the endpoint. Check the URL and API key, then try again.
error.scheme: The endpoint URL must start with https://.
error.blocked_host: That address is not reachable from the server. Use a public https endpoint.
error.server_error: The endpoint responded with a server error. Try again later.
error.loadBody: Something went wrong while fetching them. Try again.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{type}}?
disconnect.body: The stored endpoint and API key for {{type}} are deleted. This cannot be undone.

fieldMap.externalIdRequired: A remote path for the external id is required to enable inbound sync.

sync.retryAllConfirmBody: Every failed message is reset to pending. The next scheduled drain (within five minutes) attempts delivery again.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.body: Nothing has run for this integration yet. A scheduled run or Run now populates this history.

error.not_configured: Inbound sync is not configured for this integration.
error.bad_payload: The endpoint returned a response Wisal could not read.
error.payload_too_large: The endpoint's response was too large to process.
error.missing_external_id: The record had no external id and was skipped.
error.missing_name: The record had no name and was skipped.
error.duplicate: The record's email or phone matched an existing customer and was skipped.
error.bad_tier: The record's tier was not recognised; it was imported with the default tier.
error.bad_email: The record's email was not valid and was left blank.
error.integration_gone: The integration was disconnected before this message could be delivered.
error.transient: The receiver returned a temporary error; it will be retried.
error.unreachable: The request could not be sent; it will be retried.
